The residential schools also fostered a sense of unity among Indigenous peoples. This helped to break down barriers and build a collective identity among Indigenous peoples, strengthening their community bonds.


Moreover, the schools served as a catalyst for social change within Indigenous communities. In conclusion, while the residential schools system in Canada had its shortcomings and inflicted significant harm on Indigenous communities, it also had a positive impact.
